concepts: use the taught pronunciation for the complete oo word and retain its spelling
The oo spelling can represent long or short /oo/ depending on the taught word.
Readers blend consonants and use the conventional pronunciation of the complete word.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “moon” and “book”. What should a reader notice?
workedExamples.solution: Both use oo, but the vowel sound differs; use the taught pronunciation for each whole word.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “foot” with the vowel sound in “moon”. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Review the taught short-oo pronunciation of foot.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
